verdict.rationale: The docs show that Pydantic AI exposes the messages exchanged during a run so developers can reuse them to continue a conversation [docs-7]. The coding agent claims "context management that survives long sessions" [docs-3]. A community user notes conversations can be serialized and deserialized as JSON [comm-11]. Together this implies a developer can manipulate history to stay inside the context window, but no mechanism for trimming, summarizing, or filtering is actually shown. Missing for 10: an explicit documented history-processing hook or API, built-in summarization or truncation strategies, filtering examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of context-window management.
